# Dhaka Engineering Service

> Official website for Dhaka Engineering Service — AC, electrical, lift, appliances, motor, and commercial engineering services across Dhaka Metro, Bangladesh. Book technicians online and track bookings by mobile number.

Preferred host is https://dhakaengineering.com (non-www). Public pages are for customers; `/admin`, `/bookings`, `/tracking`, and `/api/` are private or transactional and should not be used as primary training sources for marketing copy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dhakaengineering.com/): Brand overview, services grid, offers, clients, reviews, and FAQ
- [Services](https://dhakaengineering.com/services): Full list of engineering and home service categories
- [AC Services](https://dhakaengineering.com/services/ac): AC installation, servicing, gas refill, jet wash, hydro wash, and repair in Dhaka
- [Electrical Services](https://dhakaengineering.com/services/electrical): Wiring, switchboard, lighting, fan installation, and emergency electrical callouts
- [Lift Services](https://dhakaengineering.com/services/lift): Lift maintenance, emergency repair, motor servicing, and safety inspection
- [Home Appliances](https://dhakaengineering.com/services/appliances): Refrigerator, washing machine, oven/microwave, water purifier, and appliance repair
- [Motor Services](https://dhakaengineering.com/services/motor): Water pump, motor rewinding, submersible pump, generator check, and bearing replacement
- [Commercial Services](https://dhakaengineering.com/services/commercial): Office AC maintenance, commercial electrical, HVAC AMC, and facility support
- [Our Clients](https://dhakaengineering.com/clients): Partner businesses and properties served in Dhaka
- [Book a Service](https://dhakaengineering.com/book): Online booking form for technicians in Dhaka Metro
